name: bestlife-holder-access
description: Seals and opens your keys with your own encryption key, and hands them only to your other Best Life workers.

ENCRYPTION_KEY.description: Your own encryption key: 32 random bytes, base64. Make one with: openssl rand -base64 32. Keep a copy somewhere safe; without it sealed keys cannot be opened.

KEYS.description: Where your sealed keys are kept (a KV namespace in your account).
